card.name: Words just before 'calculated' in dosing steps
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'be', 'when' or the start of 'recalculated' right before a form of 'calculate' or 'determine', mostly in dose-volume preparation instructions.

modes.label: Article before calculated amount
modes.description: 'the' after a verb like withdraw or draw up, just before 'calculated' or 'required volume'.
modes.example: Withdraw<< the>> calculated volume (mL) of drug

modes.label: Inside calculate
modes.description: The start of 'recalculated' or 'calculated' split into pieces, such as 'cal' before 'culated'.

modes.label: Linking word before calculated
modes.description: 'be' or 'when' leading into 'calculated' or 'determining' in formula instructions.
modes.example: can then<< be>> calculated using the following formula: Step

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict calculation words such as 'calculation' and 'calculate' next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says a number is calculated.
